drafts.title: Clashes of Duty
drafts.reasoning: This scene highlights the clash between the gruff but suspicious police captain (Hank) and the enthusiastic rookie officer (John). The dialogue should build towards a significant revelation that showcases John's dedication despite challenges.
drafts.scene: The dimly lit conference room is filled with tension as various law enforcement officers sit around a table, reviewing files on an old oak desk. The air crackles with the impending argument.

dialogue.line: So you think we solve cases by sitting here eating chips like it’s a goddamn party?
I just believe in using every resource available. Chips included.
You’re young, kid. Too damn naive to know what I’m doing for your own good.
Yeah, well, maybe I am too young to understand how corrupt everything really is.
Look at the case file again, Hank. There are inconsistencies in the witness statements and the crime scene evidence. Someone wants us to miss something important.
Inconsistencies... In this town, ain’t nothin' but lies. And that unconscious girl Sierra found? More bullshit from some bored teenager looking to make herself look important.
Sierra's name was mentioned in those statements. Maybe she can provide more information when questioned properly.
Properly my ass! You’re gonna keep your nose clean, John, or you’ll find yourself on the street as fast as a fly on hot pavement!
